title.id: Qila dan Ezra: Truk Ezra Hilang!
title.en: Qila and Ezra: Ezra's Truck Is Missing!

narration.id: Bismillah… yuk mulai! Qila dan Ezra bermain truk.
narration.en: Bismillah… let's begin! Qila and Ezra play with the truck.

praise.en: Vroom! The truck zooms so fast!

narration.id: Matahari sore. Saatnya merapikan mainan. Eh! Truk Ezra hilang!
narration.en: The sun is low. Tidy-up time! Oh no — Ezra's truck is gone!

praise.en: Ezra is sad. Let's look together!

narration.id: "Kakak sudah bilang, taruh mainan di tempatnya!" kata Qila.
narration.en: "I said, toys go back in their place!" says Qila.

praise.en: Qila gets fussy when she is tired.

narration.id: Qila melihat wajah sedih Ezra. Dia memeluk Ezra: "Kakak ada di sini."
narration.en: Qila sees Ezra's sad face. She hugs him: "I am here."

praise.en: A big sister's hug warms hearts.

narration.id: Qila punya ide seru: peta mainan! "Ayo cari truk seperti petualangan!"
narration.en: Qila has a fun idea: a toy map! "Let's hunt for the truck!"

narration.id: Qila memimpin: "Intip bawah tempat tidur!" Ezra berani intip duluan.
narration.en: Qila leads: "Peek under the bed!" Ezra bravely peeks first.

praise.id: Hih! Hanya debu dan kaus kaki!

narration.id: Qila mengguncang bantal sofa. Kloit kloit! Tidak ada truk.
narration.en: Qila puffs the sofa cushions. Puff puff! No truck here.

narration.id: Ezra menemukan jejak roda kecil! "Ikuti jejaknya, kakak!"
narration.en: Ezra spots tiny wheel tracks! "Follow the trail, sis!"

narration.id: Di balik pot, ada truknya! "Truknya ikut sembunyi-sembunyi, hihi!" Lesung pipit Ezra melebar.
narration.en: Behind the pot — the truck! "The truck was playing hide-and-seek, hihi!" Ezra's dimples grow wide.

narration.id: Qila memimpin: "Ayo buat rumah truk!" Truk punya rumah baru.
narration.en: Qila leads: "Let's build a truck house!" The truck has a new home.

praise.en: The truck loves its new home!

narration.id: Ezra memeluk Qila: "Kakak hebat!" Bermain jadi ringan. Alhamdulillah!
narration.en: Ezra hugs Qila: "You are the best!" Playing feels light now. Alhamdulillah!

praise.en: Helping each other makes hearts happy!

hikmah.id: Kakak dan adik yang saling bantu, masalah jadi ringan.
hikmah.en: When siblings help each other, every problem gets lighter.

prompts.id: Apa yang Qila lakukan supaya Ezra tidak sedih lagi?
prompts.en: What did Qila do to help Ezra feel better?

prompts.id: Kalau mainanmu hilang, siapa yang kamu minta bantu?
prompts.en: If your toy goes missing, who do you ask for help?

prompts.id: Apa yang kamu katakan saat sesuatu yang hilang ketemu?
prompts.en: What do you say when something lost is found?
